Y: The Throne of a Hundred Challengers: every weapon tagged with its owner's name. The last tag: AUREK THE TALL. Almost.
k: Torches in a full ring, mirrors behind them. Light from every side, so the king casts no shadow.
Some of the mirrors are old-world glass. They don't fog. They don't scratch. They show the room a moment late.
1: The way back to the doors.

intro.speaker: Kaldor the Kingbreaker
lines: You've heard the stories. The Mad King. He was going to march on the Mage Kingdom and set the whole world burning. I stopped him. The one who casts no shadow and I, together.
Then my patron put me in control. Build the army, it said. The Mad King was too hasty. He'd have lost. So I waited. Five hundred years.
And now we're strong enough. Strong enough to conquer the world. To end every war by being the only army left. Isn't that peace?
A hundred years ago, my patron fell silent. I stopped waiting for it to speak. Look at me: I don't age. I don't fall. I cast no shadow.
I am the one who casts no shadow now.
…Oh. And that big one behind you. I know that beard. I killed the man who wore it first. Your father, boy. The Mad King. Come and finish what he started, properly this time.
